name: Ayafuya Hypnotica
original_name: あやふやヒュプノティカ
source:
One time after school, the heroine (name changeable) kissed her classmate Hirai Masaki in a vacant, semi-conscious state.

It seemed like Masaki had hypnotised her but when he tried to do the same thing a few days later, there wasn't a single sign of it having worked.

Then, what the heroine did was──

看起来正树对她施加了催眠，但几天后他再次尝试时，却没有任何成功迹象。

于是，女主角做出了——
